layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Carnivore dental morphology close-up
features: A side-profile close-up of a friendly dinosaur's snout
The mouth is closed in a 'crocodile smile', where the top teeth overlap the bottom jaw
Teeth are smooth, conical white clay with slightly rounded tips
A single, tiny bright glint of light on one of the front teeth to add a playful sparkle
Soft red clay skin texture with gentle wrinkles around the mouth line
layer_3_action.action: An extreme close-up focusing only on the teeth and the side of the mouth. The dinosaur is 'smiling' with its mouth shut, showing the distinctive interlocking pattern of a carnivore's teeth. The background is a soft, out-of-focus jungle green. The lighting is warm and cinematic, highlighting the tactile clay surface. No text.
